Definition: Beker, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Becher means "young camel." The name is shared by several bearers: A son of Ephraim; A son of Benjamin. It turns up in Genesis 46:21, Numbers 26:35 and 1 Chronicles 7:6.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Becher is in Scripture for a reason, and no name there is an accident.
